  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document

  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS

  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeInvoice
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

output_text:
```python
from mindee import MindeeClient, InvoiceV4
import os

# Set up Mindee API credentials
mindee_api_key = os.environ["MINDEE_API_KEY"]

# Initialize Mindee client
mindee_client = MindeeClient(api_key=mindee_api_key)

# Function to extract receipt information
def extract_receipt_info(file_path: str) -> dict:
    """
    Extract merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt using Mindee Invoice OCR.
    
    Args:
        file_path (str): Path to the receipt image file.
        
    Returns:
        dict: Dictionary containing extracted information.
    """
    # Load the receipt file
    receipt_file = mindee_client.load_file(file_path)
    
    # Parse the receipt using Mindee Invoice OCR
    response = mindee_client.parse(InvoiceV4, receipt_file)
    
    # Extract merchant name
    merchant = response.invoice.supplier.name
    
    # Extract tax
    tax = response.invoice.totals.tax
    
    # Extract total amount
    total = response.invoice.totals.net
    
    # Extract items
    items = [{"name": item.name, "quantity": item.quantity, "price": item.net} for item in response.invoice.items]
    
    # Return extracted information as a dictionary
    return {
        "merchant": merchant,
        "tax": tax,
        "total": total,
        "items": items
    }

# Example usage
# receipt_info = extract_receipt_info("path/to/receipt.jpg")
# print(receipt_info)
```
